_comment: Settings of the RayTubeTracing comparison per scene (keyed by INI file name).
tesselate: num_tesselate of the reference. Its ray tubes must be fine enough to
fit inside every surface a path bounces off: the reference splits a tube only
at a single boundary edge and drops tubes whose corners land on several
surfaces (complex hits), so coarse tubes miss paths near edges and corners.
receivers: FIRST-LAST, the receiver indices compared (default: all). For
ground.ini the ground strip is only 10 m wide: beyond 1 km the reference's
tubes no longer fit on it at any affordable tessellation and it loses the
ground reflection, so the comparison covers the first kilometre.
threads: num_openmp_cpus of the reference (0 = all CPUs).
